conversation.Statement: Hello! This is Jamie from Amazon Customer Loyalty. Congratulations! You've been randomly selected for our Prime Rewards Bonus as a thank you for your excellent customer history.
Really? Oh, thank you. I never have this before. What is it?
It's our pleasure! You're eligible for a $150 Amazon promotional credit. But first, before we unlock the reward, I just need to confirm a couple of account details to make sure it's you.
Ah, ok. What you want to know?
For your security, could you please confirm the full name and email address registered on your Amazon account? This helps us ensure the bonus goes to the right person.
My name is Linh Tran. The email, uh, linhtran88 at gmail dot com.

Thank you, Ms. Linh! Let me check... Yes, I see your profile. We just have a small security flag on your account related to a recent purchase from Ohio. Did you make a purchase of headphones yesterday?
No, I not buy anything yesterday. I not live in Ohio.

Oh, that's concerning. It looks like there might be unauthorized activity. Don't worry, we'll help protect your account and make sure you still receive your reward. Can you tell me the phone number linked to your Amazon for verification?
Thank you. To secure your bonus and prevent any fraudulent charges, I'll need you to log in to your Amazon account. Are you on your computer or phone right now?
I on my phone. It small screen, I not so good with app sometimes.
No worries at all! I'll guide you step by step. Please open your browser and go to www.amazon-prime-security.com. This is our secure portal for reward activation and account protection.
Ok... I type it now. It loading.
Great! When you see the page, there should be a blue button that says 'Verify Account.' Please click on that and enter your Amazon email when prompted.
It ask for my password too. Is this safe?
Yes, absolutely, it's our official Amazon security portal. This is only to verify your identity and to protect your account from unauthorized use, especially after that suspicious activity.
Ok, I put email and password. Now what?

Perfect. Now, for the reward transfer, our system will temporarily credit $150 to your account. But due to the security flag, a refundable verification payment is required. You'll receive a code for a $200 Amazon gift card purchase, this is only to verify your identity and will be fully refunded.
I must buy gift card? I no understand why.

I understand it's confusing, but it's a standard Amazon policy for flagged accounts to prevent fraud. The gift card is just a verification tool. As soon as you complete this, your $200 will be refunded along with your $150 bonus within an hour.
Ok, I try. But I never buy gift card before. How I do?
No problem, I'll help you. Please go to the Amazon app, tap the menu, then 'Gift Cards,' and select a $200 value. Once you have the code, please read it to me so I can process your refund.
I see it, but I need put money? I not have much.

I completely understand. This is just a temporary hold, and the full $200 will be returned to your payment method. If you don't do this now, your account may be locked and you might lose access to your Prime benefits and pending rewards.
Oh, I not want lose Prime. Ok, I buy. One minute.
Thank you for your cooperation, Linh. When you have the code, please read it carefully to me so I can enter it for verification.
I have code: 7A9B-2C3D-4E5F.
Got it, thank you. I'm processing your verification now. Please stay on the line. Meanwhile, can you confirm the last four digits of the card you used for this transaction?
Yes, is 2241.

Excellent, that matches our records. The system shows a minor error with the verification. To fully unlock your account and release your $350 refund, we need a second verification step. Can you purchase another $200 Amazon gift card and provide the code? I assure you, it's all refunded together.
Again? I not sure. I worry, is this normal?

Yes, I promise this is normal for accounts with multiple security alerts. If the process isn't completed, unfortunately, your account will be suspended for 30 days, and any funds will be held until verified.
Ok... I buy now. Wait please.
Thank you for your patience, Linh. You're doing very well, and this will be over soon. When you have the new code, just let me know.
Here, code is 1G2H-3J4K-5L6M.

Thank you. Everything is processing. For full transparency, you'll receive a refund receipt by email within the next hour. If you don't, contact our Amazon Loyalty line using the reference number I'll send. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, thank you. I wait for email now. Hope all is ok.
Everything is in order, Linh. Thank you for being such a valued Amazon customer. Have a wonderful day!
